item.title: The Elder Scroll 6: Sentinel's Name Quietly Teases Juicy 'Skyrim' Sequel
item.description: Eight years after the original announcement , we've finally learned the name of Bethesda's next RPG: The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel . Since the developer didn't show any gameplay footage, all fans can really do is muse on the meaning of the title. As disappointing as that is, Elder Scrolls loreheads do have plenty to chew on.

item.title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' Director’s Next Movie Officially Picked up by Sony
item.description: The live-action Naruto movie is officially moving forward, thanks to some help from Sony. The anime adaptation from Destin Daniel Cretton ( Spider-Man: Brand New Day , Short Term 12 ) has been in the works at Lionsgate and is now set to begin production next year. This marks yet another collaboration between Cretton and Sony, a partnership that saw massive success this year with the latest Tom Holland Spider-Man movie.

item.title: D&D’s World of Warcraft Crossover Is the Bold Shake-Up the Game Needed
item.description: Wizards of the Coast has been playing things safe since updating the rules of Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition in 2024. After lead designers Jeremy Crawford and Chris Perkins left Wizards in 2025 to join Critical Role ’s Darrington Press, Wizards slowed the pace of new D&D releases. Recent books have focused mostly on updating the lore and rules for the game’s most popular campaign settings and rebalancing previously published character options. D&D’s newest release bucks the trend, delivering an ambitious collection of innovative character options, monsters, and ways to use some of the game’s less developed subsystems. It just requires venturing to a new world.

item.title: PC Games Storefront Does What Valve Won’t, Takes Action Against AI Slop
item.description: The game industry is in the middle of a huge uptick in AI-generated content. A whopping 54.6% of titles added to Steam in October 2026 included an AI disclosure label, marking the first month that more games had the label than not. For comparison, 18.3% of games added to the platform in 2025 had an AI disclosure label.

item.title: Zach Cregger's Sci-Fi Masterpiece Made One Brilliant Change to Its Monster: 'It Just Looks Creepier'
item.description: In the weeks after the release of Resident Evil , a viral clip showed several acrobatic performers tied together at the waist and practicing the movements of the mutated, cartwheeling mass of limbs known as the "Pedestrian" in Cregger's adaptation of the horror video game franchise . This has led some people online to assume that the creature in the film was actually a practical effect, with a bit of CGI on top. But as Smith explains, that is an incorrect assumption.

item.title: Jason Statham and Guy Ritchie Officially Reunite for New Action-Thriller
item.description: Guy Ritchie and Jason Statham have worked together numerous times over the years, bringing us fun, action-packed flicks. The duo will soon be doing it again, not only in the upcoming Viva La Madness but also in Netflix 's newly announced film, Dogfight .

item.title: Bethesda Officially Confirms The Elder Scrolls 6 Name
item.description: Bethesda has finally revealed the name of the next Elder Scrolls game. The long-awaited RPG will be titled The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel . Just a few days ago, fans of the series started theorizing this would be the title and now it's confirmed. Todd Howard made the announcement in a video celebrating Bethesda Softworks' 40th anniversary.

item.title: Scream Star Confirms She’s Returning for Sequel
item.description: One of the definitive scream queens is coming back for another night with Ghostface. Neve Campbell confirmed she will return as Sidney Prescott (now Evans) in Scream 8 .
